about: Custom types P3: a cell of a boot-loaded mod (harness_type_gcell, map all) names newt, the type of the map mod harness_map_type (map harness_t). Loading a save made on harness_t from the menu appends the map mod's types in the deferred load, after the cell was registered: the cell must still hold newt, and its own mon_spr_newt set.

quit to menu, then load the save: the map mod is loaded in the deferred load
